name: Sentry
description: Sentry is an application monitoring and debugging platform for production Issues, Events, Exceptions, Stacktraces, releases, performance, and operational telemetry.
agentUseSummary: Connect with Relay's registered public device OAuth client and exact org:read, project:read, event:read, and event:write scopes. Relay exposes six curated wrappers for bounded Project and Issue triage, redacted Event debugging, local update preparation, and one approval-gated Issue workflow update; sensitive telemetry, broad export, bulk/destructive/admin operations, Seer, arbitrary API access, and raw MCP remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: RELAY_SENTRY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Relay Sentry device OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway must contain the registered public Relay client ID. Device authorization uses no desktop secret or callback.

credentialRequirements.name: SENTRY_ORGANIZATION
credentialRequirements.label: Consented Sentry Organization
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact Organization selected during consent and enforced by every Relay wrapper.

capabilities.label: Issue triage
capabilities.description: Read bounded Projects, Issues, and redacted Events.

capabilities.label: Issue workflow
capabilities.description: Prepare and approval-gate one exact Issue workflow update.

allowed.label: List Projects
allowed.description: List at most 25 redacted Project summaries for the consented Organization.

allowed.label: Search Issues
allowed.description: Search at most 25 Issues with bounded project, environment, query, period, and sort filters.

allowed.label: Read Issue
allowed.description: Read one Issue with semantic workflow fields and a redacted latest Event summary.

allowed.label: Read Event
allowed.description: Read one Event with bounded message, Exception, Tag, and Stacktrace summaries.

allowed.label: Prepare Issue update
allowed.description: Prepare one exact status, substatus, or priority update locally without changing Sentry.

approvalRequired.label: Update Issue workflow
approvalRequired.description: Apply one previously approved exact status, substatus, or priority update to one Issue.

blocked.label: Export sensitive telemetry
blocked.description: Broad Issue/Event export, raw request/user/context/breadcrumb data, attachments, logs, profiles, replays, and source files are outside V1.

blocked.label: Bulk or delete Sentry data
blocked.description: Bulk mutations and Issue, Event, snapshot, Project, or Organization deletion are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change artifacts or administration
blocked.description: Releases, deploys, source maps, files, alerts, integrations, hooks, teams, members, projects, and organization administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw Sentry MCP or API
blocked.description: Raw MCP, Seer/AI, arbitrary hosts, paths, queries, pagination, synchronization, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four bounded reads and local update preparation run automatically; an exact Issue workflow update requires Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same six curated wrappers run without per-action approval; bulk, destructive, sensitive, admin, arbitrary, and raw MCP access remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six curated Sentry wrappers and attaches refreshed Organization-scoped OAuth access server-side.
Railway mounts six curated Sentry wrappers and attaches refreshed Organization-scoped OAuth access server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's public Sentry device OAuth client is not yet registered/configured, and no authorized Organization is available for consent, refresh, revocation, semantic-read, or Issue-update acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the public device client, set RELAY_SENTRY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID on Railway, then complete one Organization consent, refresh/revocation, six-wrapper Safe/Dangerous acceptance, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: Sentry documents RFC 8628 device authorization, a registered public client ID, organization-scoped consent, device and token endpoints, polling intervals/errors, access tokens, refresh tokens, and no callback requirement.
Sentry documents the granular organization, project, and event read/write permission families used by the exact four-scope V1 grant.
Sentry documents Organization-scoped bounded Project listing.
Sentry documents Organization Issue search with project, environment, query, period, sort, and result-limit filters.
Sentry documents one-Issue retrieval with basic stats and latest Event summary.
Sentry documents retrieval of one Project Event for bounded debugging context.
Sentry documents exact individual Issue workflow updates; Relay does not expose the bulk endpoint.
Sentry publishes an official MCP implementation; Relay deliberately exposes only its six curated native REST wrappers.
